name: How can I prevent future storm damage to my home's exterior paint?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent future storm damage to my home's exterior paint?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing future storm damage involves proactive maintenance. Regularly inspect your home for cracked caulk, loose siding, or peeling paint and address these issues promptly. Ensure your gutters and downspouts are clear and properly divert water away from your foundation and walls. Trimming overhanging tree branches reduces the risk of impact damage during high winds. Using high-quality, durable exterior paints and finishes during initial application or repainting also provides better long-term protection.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent future storm damage by maintaining caulk, siding, and gutters, trimming trees, and using high-quality, durable exterior paints.
